name: Flohdom Bahrenfelder Trabrennbahn
facts: Hamburg's first weekly flea market, per the organiser
used goods and a smaller share of new goods
covered 3 m stalls and open pitches, traders may sell from vehicles
on the open ground at the Bahrenfeld trotting track, Luruper Chaussee
notes: Organiser lists only ~4 bookable weeks ahead (Sat 26 Sep, 10/17/24 Oct; Wed 23/30 Sep, 7–28 Oct), rest derived from the stated rhythm. Sat 3 Oct (Tag der Deutschen Einheit) is absent from their list and dropped; Sat 26 Dec dropped by the same logic, unconfirmed. Homepage says 07:00–15:00, booking pages say 7 am–4 pm; recorded the homepage. Entry fee not stated. Imprint e-mail is anmeldung@, bookings go to reservierung@kreaktiva.de.

description.de: Zweimal die Woche, mittwochs und samstags von 7 bis 15 Uhr, auf dem Freigelände der Trabrennbahn Bahrenfeld. Überwiegend Gebrauchtes, ein kleinerer Teil Neuware; verkauft wird an überdachten Ständen, auf offenen Plätzen und aus dem Auto. Der Veranstalter nennt ihn Hamburgs ersten Wochenflohmarkt.
description.en: Twice a week, Wednesdays and Saturdays from 7 to 3, on the open ground of the Bahrenfeld trotting track. Mostly used goods with a smaller share of new stock, sold from covered stalls, open pitches and car boots. The organiser calls it Hamburg's first weekly flea market.
